name: spotify-mcp
description: Local-first Spotify tools for music, podcasts, safe playlists, and DJ planning.

interface.shortDescription: Use Spotify naturally and safely from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Search music and podcasts, control Spotify, rediscover music across your full Liked Songs history, build verified playlists, and plan snapshot-safe DJ running orders. Results include canonical Spotify links and optional interactive cards. Credentials stay on your machine and uncertain writes are never retried blindly.
